brief.meaningEn: Fail to provide the help or reliability that someone expected.
brief.meaningZh: 沒有提供某人原本期望的協助或可靠表現，使其失望。
brief.grammar: Pattern: a person/service/tool lets, let or has let + me/you/him/her/us/them + down; put the person pronoun between let and down. The subject fails expected support.
brief.register: Neutral everyday conversation, sometimes disappointed in tone. A customer, passenger or teammate may say it to someone reviewing a missed promise or unreliable help.
brief.boundaryZh: 與 tie someone down 的限制自由、wear someone down 的逐漸耗弱不同；本課是原本依靠的支援未能兌現。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把任何不喜歡的結果都叫 lets them down；要說明先前的合理期待。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出依賴甚麼協助、它在哪裏失靈，以及對使用者的影響。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 34, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The map app sometimes lets them down in remote areas.

listening.en: A ferry information service promised alerts before schedule changes. During a sudden cancellation, no alert reached waiting passengers, and the service let them down when they needed it.
listening.zh: 渡輪資訊服務承諾在班次改動前通知乘客；突然取消航班時，候船乘客卻沒有收到通知。服務在最需要時辜負了他們。
listening.promptZh: 為何說服務 let them down？

options.en: Passengers expected an alert, but the service failed when a sailing was cancelled.
options.zh: 乘客原本期望收到通知，航班取消時服務卻未能做到。

options.en: Passengers disliked the colour of the alert screen.
options.zh: 乘客不喜歡通知畫面的顏色。

options.en: The service sent a timely warning and passengers changed plans.
options.zh: 服務及時警告乘客，乘客因而改變計劃。

options.en: The ferry route was longer than passengers had hoped.
options.zh: 渡輪航線比乘客希望的更長。

listening.explanationZh: 服務承諾提供取消通知，關鍵時刻卻沒有做到；這是未兌現預期協助。

reply.promptEn: Why did passengers lose confidence in the ferry information service?
reply.promptZh: （乘客為何較不信任渡輪資訊服務？）

options.en: It failed to send the cancellation alert they relied on.
options.zh: 他們依賴的取消通知沒有發出。

options.en: Its promised warning did not arrive before they waited at the pier.
options.zh: 原本承諾的通知在他們到碼頭等候前沒有送到。

options.en: It let them down at the moment they needed an update.
options.zh: 他們最需要最新消息時，服務辜負了他們。

options.en: They could no longer rely on the promised alerts about changed sailings.
options.zh: 他們已無法依靠承諾提供的班次變動通知。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋承諾的通知沒有兌現；金句以 let down 表達原本依靠的支援失效。

options.en: The app let them down because its promised delay alert failed when it mattered.
options.zh: 程式在關鍵時沒有發出承諾的延誤通知，辜負了家長。

options.en: The app wore them down by asking them to read updates every hour.
options.zh: 程式要求他們每小時查看更新，令他們逐漸疲憊。

options.en: The app tied them down to one route and banned every alternative.
options.zh: 程式限制他們只能走一條路，禁止一切替代方案。

scene.explanationZh: 家長合理依賴延誤通知，卻未收到；另兩句是不同片語的意思，情境沒有相應證據。
scene.promptZh: 學校校車程式承諾車輛延誤時會通知家長，卻在一次大延誤中沒有發出訊息，家長等了很久才知情。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A hotline promises a callback by noon but never calls while users need urgent advice.
options.zh: 熱線承諾中午前回電，使用者急需建議卻沒收到。

options.en: A timetable service sends an accurate early alert, allowing travellers to change plans.
options.zh: 時間表服務及早發出準確通知，旅客得以改變計劃。

options.en: A booking system confirms seats, then loses the booking just before departure.
options.zh: 訂位系統確認座位，出發前卻遺失紀錄。

contrast.explanationZh: 服務如期提供有用通知，沒有辜負依賴它的人；另兩項未兌現承諾。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 a service let them down？

options.en: It has let you down when you need confirmation; contact the organiser now and keep your payment record.
options.zh: 你需要確認時，平台卻辜負了你；現在聯絡主辦者，並保留付款紀錄。

options.en: A missing email proves you never registered, even though you have a payment record.
options.zh: 雖有付款紀錄，沒收到電郵仍證明你從未報名。

options.en: The platform’s colour scheme is the main problem, rather than the missing confirmation.
options.zh: 主要問題是平台配色，而非缺少確認電郵。

dialogue.explanationZh: 付款後仍沒有承諾的確認，屬支援失效；建議直接核實並保留證據。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「報名平台說會寄確認電郵，但我付款後三天仍沒有收到，活動明天就開始。」你怎樣回應最貼切？

speaking.en: The booking platform let them down when the promised confirmation never arrived.
speaking.zh: 訂位平台承諾的確認訊息沒有送到，辜負了他們。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出未能兌現的承諾。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區印刷店承諾星期五前送達活動海報，卻錯過期限，令義工失去一個周末的宣傳時間。店方道歉、安排急印，並改善訂單追蹤。用一至兩句英文描述期望、失敗及補救。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出星期五前送貨的承諾未兌現、義工失去宣傳時間，以及急印和改善追蹤；不要只說義工不喜歡海報設計。

examples.en: The print shop promised volunteers posters by Friday but let them down when it missed the deadline, costing them a weekend of promotion; it apologised, rushed the order and improved its tracking.
examples.zh: 印刷店承諾星期五前把海報送給義工，卻錯過期限，令他們失去一個周末的宣傳時間，辜負了他們；店方道歉、急印訂單並改善追蹤。

examples.en: The volunteers expected posters by Friday, but the late delivery let them down and cut their publicity time; the shop offered rush printing and a better order tracker.
examples.zh: 義工原本期望星期五前收到海報，延遲送貨卻令宣傳時間縮短，辜負了他們；店方提供急印及較完善的訂單追蹤。

takeaways.en: The weather service let us down when the warning arrived after the storm.
takeaways.zh: 天氣服務在風暴後才發出警告，辜負了我們。

takeaways.en: When a team expects help, a promised helper who does not arrive can let them down on a busy day.
takeaways.zh: 承諾幫忙的人在忙碌日子沒有到場，可能辜負團隊。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Do the mental work or judgment instead of a person, beyond merely supplying information.
brief.meaningZh: 代替某人思考或作判斷，而不只是提供資料。
brief.grammar: Pattern: a person/tool can or cannot think on + my/your/his/her/our/their + behalf; think/thinks/thought are possible verb forms. On behalf of + noun is a separate construction.
brief.register: Neutral explanatory or advisory language. A teacher, adviser or colleague may say it to a decision-maker who has useful data but still needs to exercise judgment.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是誰負責理解和判斷；與工具作出運算、整理資訊不同，也不必一概拒用工具。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把工具顯示答案等同它理解使用者的目標；人仍須檢查前提與結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出工具能做甚麼，以及哪個關鍵判斷仍要由使用者作出。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 34, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A calculator cannot think on your behalf.

listening.en: A calculator gave the correct total for a class trip. The organiser still had to decide whether every student could afford the cost; it could calculate, but it could not think on her behalf.
listening.zh: 計算機算出班級旅行的正確總費用，但主辦同學仍須判斷每個學生能否負擔。它能計算，卻不能替她作判斷。
listening.promptZh: 為何說計算機不能 think on her behalf？

options.en: It gives a total but cannot decide whether the trip is affordable for everyone.
options.zh: 它可算出總額，卻不能判斷旅費是否人人負擔得起。

options.en: It made an arithmetic error that the organiser must correct.
options.zh: 它算錯數字，主辦同學須更正。

options.en: It can choose which student should receive financial help.
options.zh: 它可以決定哪位學生應獲資助。

options.en: It remembers the trip date better than the organiser does.
options.zh: 它比主辦同學更記得旅行日期。

listening.explanationZh: 運算正確不等於能衡量學生的實際負擔；價值判斷仍在人。

reply.promptEn: Why did the organiser review the calculator’s total before setting the trip price?
reply.promptZh: （主辦同學為何在訂旅行費用前檢視計算結果？）

options.en: She still had to consider what the students could afford.
options.zh: 她仍須考慮學生能負擔多少。

options.en: The number alone did not settle whether the trip was fair for everyone.
options.zh: 單靠數字不能判斷旅行費用對所有人是否公平。

options.en: The calculator could not think on her behalf about families’ different circumstances.
options.zh: 計算機不能替她考慮各家庭不同處境。

options.en: She needed to use the total alongside information about the students.
options.zh: 她需要把總額與學生的其他情況一併考慮。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明計算結果只是資料，訂價仍要顧及不同家庭；金句指出工具不能代人思考。

options.en: The tool cannot think on their behalf about needs missing from its information.
options.zh: 工具無法替老師考慮沒有輸入的需要。

options.en: The shortest schedule must always be the fairest one.
options.zh: 最短的時間表必然最公平。

options.en: Because one need was missed, no scheduling tool can ever help teachers.
options.zh: 因有一項需要被漏掉，任何排程工具都不可能幫到老師。

scene.explanationZh: 工具可排程，但缺少無障礙資訊時，老師仍須作實際判斷。
scene.promptZh: 學校排程工具提出最省時間的場地安排，卻不知道輪椅使用者需要無障礙通道；老師須重新檢查安排。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A calculator totals prices, while you decide whether the purchase fits your budget.
options.zh: 計算機合計價格，你仍自行判斷購買是否符合預算。

options.en: A person asks an experienced adviser to weigh the circumstances, then jointly discusses a decision.
options.zh: 有人請有經驗的顧問衡量情況，然後雙方共同商討決定。

options.en: A map app suggests a fast route, while you assess whether it is safe in heavy rain.
options.zh: 地圖程式建議最快路線，你仍評估大雨中是否安全。

contrast.explanationZh: 這是人與人共同商討，不是工具運算後仍需由使用者判斷的情況。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持說 a tool cannot think on your behalf？

options.en: It can organise the data, but it cannot think on your behalf about your interests and circumstances.
options.zh: 它可整理數據，但不能替你考慮自己的興趣和處境。

options.en: Its list proves the highest-scoring subject is right for every student.
options.zh: 它的清單證明分數最高的科目適合每個學生。

options.en: If the data are useful, you need not discuss the choice with anyone else.
options.zh: 數據既然有用，你便毋須再與任何人討論選科。

dialogue.explanationZh: 程式提供資訊有用，但興趣與處境仍須由學生考慮，可再向人請教。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「選科程式列出各科升學數據，應該可以直接替我選好科目吧？」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: A map can show routes, but it cannot think on your behalf about what matters most on the trip.
speaking.zh: 地圖能顯示路線，但不能替你判斷旅程中甚麼最重要。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再區分工具提供的資料與人的判斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區中心用軟件比較兩個活動場地的租金和容量，軟件指出較便宜的一個，但該場地沒有適合長者的升降機。籌委會仍要判斷哪個場地合適。用一至兩句英文描述軟件的幫助與判斷界線。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出軟件提供租金及容量比較、較便宜場地欠缺升降機，以及籌委會須考慮長者需要；不要說軟件完全無用。

examples.en: The community centre’s committee compared rent and capacity with software, but the cheaper hall lacked a lift; the tool could not think on their behalf about older guests’ access.
examples.zh: 社區中心籌委會用軟件比較租金與容量，但較便宜的場地沒有升降機；工具無法替籌委會考慮長者的出入需要。

examples.en: Although the program found a cheaper venue with enough seats, it could not think on our behalf about the missing lift, so we weighed the older visitors’ needs ourselves.
examples.zh: 程式找出一個較便宜、座位足夠的場地，但它無法替我們考慮欠缺升降機的問題，因此我們自行衡量年長訪客的需要。

takeaways.en: Search results can inform us, but they cannot think on our behalf.
takeaways.zh: 搜尋結果可提供資料，但不能替我們作判斷。

takeaways.en: A calculator cannot think on your behalf when the question involves people’s needs.
takeaways.zh: 涉及人的需要時，計算機無法替你思考。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: At risk or dependent on the outcome of a decision or event.
brief.meaningZh: 重要的事物可能因決定或結果而得失。
brief.grammar: Pattern: X is/was/will be at stake; the inversion at stake is X is also natural. X names an important interest that the decision may put at risk.
brief.register: Neutral to formal discussion of meaningful decisions. A resident, parent or organiser may say it to other stakeholders before a vote or policy choice; avoid implying loss is certain.
brief.boundaryZh: at stake 可關乎信任、經費或安全；與 a matter of life and death 的生死級別不同，不必把風險誇大。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把任何小偏好都說成 at stake；亦不要把有風險當成損失必然發生。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出甚麼重要事物可能受影響，以及哪項決定造成風險。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 37, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Children's safety is at stake in this decision.

listening.en: The town council was deciding whether to close the only evening bus route. Workers who finish late might lose a reliable way home. Their access to transport was at stake in the vote.
listening.zh: 市議會正決定是否取消唯一的晚間巴士線。晚下班的員工可能失去可靠的回家方法；他們的交通選擇在投票中面臨風險。

options.en: Late workers’ reliable transport home could be lost.
options.zh: 晚下班員工可靠的回家交通可能失去。

options.en: The council had already cancelled every bus route.
options.zh: 市議會已取消所有巴士線。

options.en: Only the colour of the bus timetable might change.
options.zh: 只有巴士時間表的顏色可能改變。

options.en: The vote would decide whether workers could change jobs.
options.zh: 投票會決定員工可否轉工。

listening.explanationZh: 唯一晚間巴士線可能被取消，晚下班員工的重要交通選擇因此受影響；結果尚未確定。

reply.promptEn: Why did late-shift workers attend the council meeting?
reply.promptZh: （晚班員工為何出席市議會會議？）

options.en: They wanted to speak for the bus route they depend on.
options.zh: 他們想為自己依賴的巴士路線發聲。

options.en: They could lose their reliable journey home if the route closed.
options.zh: 路線若取消，他們可能失去可靠的回家方法。

options.en: Their access to evening transport was at stake.
options.zh: 他們使用晚間交通的機會正面臨風險。

options.en: They hoped councillors would consider workers before voting.
options.zh: 他們希望議員投票前考慮晚班員工。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理回答出席原因；金句明確指出投票結果攸關的重要交通選擇。

options.en: Accessible outdoor space is at stake in the vote.
options.zh: 這次投票攸關無障礙戶外空間。

options.en: Every resident is certain to lose access to all parks.
options.zh: 所有居民一定會失去使用所有公園的機會。

options.en: The only issue is the colour of the new car park signs.
options.zh: 唯一問題是新停車場告示牌的顏色。

scene.explanationZh: 無障礙花園可能被改建，重要的戶外空間面臨損失；不要把可能風險說成已確定的全面失去。
scene.promptZh: 居民正表決是否把社區唯一的無障礙花園改建為停車場，輪椅使用者可能失去方便進入的戶外空間。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A vote may remove the only free clinic in the district.
options.zh: 投票可能令區內唯一免費診所關閉。

options.en: Two equally priced pens differ only in barrel colour, which the buyer does not mind.
options.zh: 兩支同價原子筆只差筆身顏色，買家並不介意。

options.en: A school decision may cut the only wheelchair-accessible entrance.
options.zh: 學校決定可能取消唯一的輪椅通道入口。

contrast.explanationZh: 選擇不影響買家在意的重要利益；另外兩項有實質服務或通道可能受損。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 at stake？

options.en: Families’ access to free care is at stake; let us explain its value before the vote.
options.zh: 家庭使用免費照顧服務的機會面臨風險；表決前我們應解釋它的價值。

options.en: The service has already closed, so no decision remains.
options.zh: 服務已經關閉，因此已沒有決定要作。

options.en: Because the vote is pending, nothing important could possibly be affected.
options.zh: 表決尚未進行，所以絕不可能影響重要事物。

dialogue.explanationZh: 唯一免費服務可能被削減，家庭利益正面臨風險；尚未表決不代表已失去或毫無風險。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「社區中心可能削減唯一的免費課後照顧服務，但委員會還未表決。」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: When the only accessible route is threatened, more than convenience is at stake.
speaking.zh: 唯一無障礙通道受威脅時，攸關的不只是方便與否。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪項重要利益可能受損。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校正考慮取消唯一的免費午膳補助，尚未決定。部分家庭依靠該補助讓孩子每天有足夠食物。家長在會議上說明風險。用一至兩句英文描述甚麼可能受影響，以及決定仍未作出。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出免費午膳補助可能取消、依靠補助的孩子每日飲食可能受影響，以及決定尚未確定；不要說每個孩子已經挨餓。

examples.en: Children’s access to a daily meal is at stake as the school considers ending its only free lunch support; parents raised the concern before any final decision.
examples.zh: 學校考慮取消唯一的免費午膳補助，孩子每天獲得一餐的機會因而面臨風險；家長在最終決定前提出憂慮。

examples.en: The school has not decided yet, but food support for families who rely on the free lunches is at stake, so parents explained the possible impact.
examples.zh: 學校尚未決定，但依靠免費午膳的家庭可能失去食物支援，因此家長說明潛在影響。

glossary.en: families who rely on the free lunches

takeaways.en: A trusted service is at stake when a council considers closing it.
takeaways.zh: 議會考慮關閉受信賴的服務時，該服務便面臨風險。

takeaways.en: At stake here is access to the only free class in the area.
takeaways.zh: 這裏攸關的是使用區內唯一免費課堂的機會。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: throw the baby out with the bathwater
lessons.titleZh: 去除問題時連好處也丟掉

target.pattern: \b(?:throw|throws|threw|throwing) the baby out with the bathwater\b

brief.meaningEn: Discard something valuable while trying to remove a problem.
brief.meaningZh: 試圖排除問題時，連有價值的部分也一併丟掉。
brief.grammar: Pattern: throw/throws/threw/throwing the baby out with the bathwater. The idiom is a fixed verb phrase; the subject is the person or decision that discards value while removing a problem.
brief.register: Informal to neutral discussion and advice. A colleague, moderator or organiser may say it to a group considering an overbroad fix, then name the useful part to keep.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是刪除壞處時誤丟好處；不是說任何改革都不好，也不是字面嬰兒和洗澡水。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只說「別改」；應清楚指出要處理的問題和要保留的價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出壞處、值得保留的部分，以及更精準的修改方法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 37, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Do not throw the baby out with the bathwater when revising the rules.
sources.expression: throw the baby out with the bathwater

listening.en: The residents’ online group had spam posts, but its archive held useful repair advice. Deleting the entire group would throw the baby out with the bathwater; the moderators chose to remove spam and keep the archive.
listening.zh: 居民網上群組有垃圾訊息，但舊帖保存了有用的維修建議。刪除整個群組會在去除問題時連好處也丟掉；管理員選擇刪垃圾訊息、保留舊帖。
listening.promptZh: 為何刪除整個群組會 throw the baby out with the bathwater？

options.en: It would remove useful advice along with the spam.
options.zh: 它會在刪去垃圾訊息時也刪去有用建議。

options.en: It would require residents to report spam before a moderator acts.
options.zh: 它會要求居民在管理員處理前先舉報垃圾訊息。

options.en: It would keep the archive while removing only unwanted posts.
options.zh: 它會保留舊帖，只刪除不需要的訊息。

options.en: It would make the group easier to search without losing any information.
options.zh: 它會令群組更易搜尋，而且不失去任何資料。

listening.explanationZh: 整個刪除會同時失去有用舊帖；精準處理垃圾訊息能保留價值。

reply.promptEn: How should we handle spam in the residents’ group without losing its repair archive?
reply.promptZh: （我們如何處理居民群組的垃圾訊息，同時保留維修舊帖？）

options.en: Remove spam posts while keeping the useful repair threads.
options.zh: 刪去垃圾訊息，同時保留有用的維修討論。

options.en: Strengthen moderation and preserve the advice residents still use.
options.zh: 加強管理，保留居民仍會參考的建議。

options.en: Do not throw the baby out with the bathwater; filter the spam instead of deleting the group.
options.zh: 不要去除問題時連好處也丟掉；應過濾垃圾訊息，而非刪除整個群組。

options.en: Archive the helpful threads and restrict repeat spammers.
options.zh: 封存有用討論，並限制屢次發垃圾訊息的人。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都處理垃圾訊息並保留有用資訊；金句概括不能在解決壞處時丟掉好處。

options.en: Deleting the whole site would throw the baby out with the bathwater; moderate the comments and keep the notes.
options.zh: 刪掉整個網站會連有用筆記也丟掉；應管理留言並保留筆記。

options.en: All comments should remain visible because the reading notes are useful.
options.zh: 讀書筆記有用，所以所有留言都應保留。

options.en: The only valuable part of the site is the inappropriate comments.
options.zh: 網站唯一有價值的部分是不當留言。

scene.explanationZh: 整站刪除會同時失去有用筆記；保留所有不當留言則沒有處理問題。
scene.promptZh: 學校閱讀網站的留言區出現少量不當訊息，但多年來的讀書筆記仍有用。有人建議刪除整個網站。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Remove inaccurate pages from a guide but retain its tested instructions.
options.zh: 從指南刪去不準確頁面，保留已驗證的指示。

options.en: Delete an entire helpful guide because one section contains a correctable error.
options.zh: 指南有一節可更正的錯誤，便把整份有用指南刪掉。

options.en: Block abusive comments while preserving useful discussion.
options.zh: 封鎖惡意留言，同時保留有用討論。

contrast.explanationZh: 因可更正的一節而刪除整份有用指南，就是解決問題時也丟掉價值。
contrast.promptZh: 哪項做法最不符合避免 throw the baby out with the bathwater？

options.en: That would throw the baby out with the bathwater; rewrite those two questions and keep the useful ones.
options.zh: 那會在去除問題時連好處也丟掉；改寫那兩題，保留有用題目吧。

options.en: The unclear questions are harmless, so no change is needed.
options.zh: 兩條不清楚的題目沒有影響，毋須修改。

options.en: Every other question must be flawed too, because two are unclear.
options.zh: 有兩條題目不清楚，便表示其餘題目一定也有問題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 兩條題目需改，但其餘題目仍有用；精準修改勝過整份棄用。
dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「活動問卷裏有兩條問題寫得不清楚，我們不如整份問卷都不要用了。」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: Removing useful lessons along with one error would throw the baby out with the bathwater.
speaking.zh: 因一個錯誤而連有用課堂內容也刪去，就是去除問題時連好處也丟掉。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪部分應修正、哪部分應保留。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區花園的網上報名表有一條含糊問題，但其餘問題可幫義工安排合適工作。有人主張取消整份表格。團隊決定改寫含糊一題，保留有用資料。用一至兩句英文說明較精準的做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出一條問題含糊、其他問題有助分配工作，以及改寫該題並保留表格；不要說所有問題都壞。

examples.en: Scrapping the whole sign-up form would throw the baby out with the bathwater: one question is unclear, but the others help assign volunteers, so the team rewrote that item.
examples.zh: 整份報名表廢掉會在去除問題時連好處也丟掉：只有一題含糊，其他題有助分配義工，因此團隊改寫那一題。

examples.en: The group avoided throwing the baby out with the bathwater by revising the confusing question and keeping the useful answers that guide volunteer roles.
examples.zh: 團隊改寫含糊的問題，保留有助分配義工工作的答案，避免在去除問題時連好處也丟掉。

takeaways.en: Do not throw the baby out with the bathwater when only one section needs fixing.
takeaways.zh: 如果只有一節需要修正，就不要連有用部分也丟掉。

takeaways.en: They threw the baby out with the bathwater by deleting the archive to remove a few spam posts.
takeaways.zh: 他們為刪少量垃圾訊息而把舊帖一併刪除，連有用部分也丟掉。
